hypotheses.S1_joint_advantage_is_not_a_single_scale: The joint program has at least three times the local route's median exact KL at every scale and corpus.
hypotheses.S2_joint_effect_direction_is_scale_stabl: The joint program's Fisher cosine to its 1% effect is at least 0.90 through 10% and at least 0.75 at 20% on both corpora.
hypotheses.S3_joint_program_beats_unit_diagonal: The joint program has at least twice the unit-diagonal route's median exact KL at every scale and corpus.
hypotheses.S4_joint_effect_is_monotonic: Joint-program median exact KL increases monotonically over the four scales on both corpora.
hypotheses.S5_local_query_tradeoff_persists: The local route has a larger median absolute direct query effect than the joint program at every scale and corpus.
